name: mili-ssm
description: mili-ssm's Claude Code plugins: agent-skills (specialist skills and agents) and opt-in mods.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Generic specialist skills and agents that complement Superpowers and Playwright.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Mod: compact progress of the active implementation plan, only while there is one: status line (all surfaces) plus a card above the prompt (terminal, desktop).

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Mod: per interaction cycle (your prompt to your next one), how long since you wrote and what it took: live status line, one dim line when the next prompt closes the cycle, with tokens per model and calls, skills and agents (agents' own work included), plus session totals; /usage-band for a summary.

plugins.name: tool-fold
plugins.description: Mod: tool calls, skills and agents in the chat fold into compact lines; a run of them into one group line with a Haiku summary. Running agents keep a live card in the chat (mission, model, task progress, last calls) until they end. Agent notices shrink to one line.
